page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-960GB-4xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for heavy computational workloads. It features 48 physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processors running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 960.0 GB of system memory, providing 20.0 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, delivering a combined 320 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning external storage solutions must be utilized.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier performance in memory bandwidth and multi-threaded decompression. The small-block read-only memory bandwidth reached 7,649.82 GB/sec, while large-block read and write bandwidths measured 316.04 GB/sec and 135.84 GB/sec respectively. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieved 615.79 GB/sec, and the Passmark CPU score of 85,426.66 highlights strong multi-core processing capabilities. For AI workloads, prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model reached 10,308.98 tokens/sec, and text generation achieved 377.14 tokens/sec.

Given the high density of enterprise-grade hardware, including four H100 GPUs and nearly a terabyte of system memory, this server represents a high-resource tier. The qualitative cost efficiency is aligned with large-scale parallel processing where GPU-to-CPU and memory-to-core ratios are critical. The lack of local storage is a notable tradeoff, requiring network-attached storage configurations. This server is suited for large-scale machine learning, LLM inference, data science pipelines, and complex scientific simulations.
